title: Analysis of pharmaceuticals in fish using ultrasound extraction and dispersive spe clean-up on que Z-Sep/C18 followed by LC-QToF-MS detection
author: Peña-Herrera, Montemurro, et al.
materials: The chromatographic separation of the analytes was achieved using an UPLC Exion LC AD system (SCIEX, MA) using a thermostated (40 °C) EVO C18 KINETEX packed column (50 mm × 2.1 mm, 2.6 μm, Phenomenex, Torrance, CA). At a flow rate of 0.8 mL min−1 the chromatographic separation was carried out in 11 min using as mobile phases 5 mmol L −1 ammonium acetate + 0.05% V/V formic acid in water (A) and 0.05% V/V formic acid in acetonitrile (B). The injection volume was 10 µL and the autosampler was thermostated at 8 °C. The gradient was as follows: initial conditions (5% B) were maintained for 0.3 min, then was increased to 25% in 5.6 min and then further increased to 40% in the following 1.7 min. Finally, the organic phase increased until 98% in 1.3 min and held for 1.0 min before returning to the initial conditions in 0.1 min, which were maintained for 1.0 min. Fig. 1 shows an example of the chromatographic separation of the validated compounds achieved with this methodology in 11 min. In this case, the sample extract for validation was fortified with the target compounds at a concentration of 50 ng ml−1Fig. 1Example of chromatograms for validated PhACs in matrix extracted spiked at 50 ng. mL-1.Fig. 1:

steps.title: Weigh and spike sample
steps.instruction: Place 0.5 g of fresh fish muscle into a 2 mL Eppendorf Safe‑Lock tube, add 12.5 ng internal standard (solution prepared in methanol at 100 ng mL⁻¹) and vortex for 1 min; let stand for 15 min.

steps.title: Add extraction solvent and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of an acetonitrile/isopropanol (1:1) mixture acidified with concentrated formic acid (≥98%) to a final concentration of 0.1 % v/v, vortex to homogenize.

steps.title: Ultrasound extraction
steps.instruction: Expose the tube to ultrasound for 10 min using a Fisherbrand FB15064 sonicator.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 12 min at 20 817 g and –2 °C.

steps.title: Dispersive SPE clean‑up
steps.instruction: Transfer 0.750 µL of the supernatant into a 2 mL vial containing Supel™ QuE Z‑Sep/C18 sorbent, vortex, then centrifuge for 6 min at the same speed and temperature.

steps.title: Collect cleaned extract
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of the resulting supernatant into a 2 mL HPLC glass vial.

steps.title: Evaporate and reconstitute
steps.instruction: Evaporate the solvent under a gentle stream of nitrogen, then reconstitute the residue with 500 µL of a 9:1 (v/v) mixture of 5 nmol L⁻¹ ammonium acetate solution and acetonitrile; vortex for 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare LC‑QTOF‑HRMS system
steps.instruction: Set up a UPLC Exion LC AD system with an EVO C18 KINETEX column (50 mm × 2.1 mm, 2.6 µm) thermostated at 40 °C; set flow rate to 0.8 mL min⁻¹; keep autosampler at 8 °C; use mobile phase A (5 mmol L⁻¹ ammonium acetate + 0.05 % v/v formic acid in water) and mobile phase B (0.05 % v/v formic acid in acetonitrile).

steps.title: Inject and run gradient
steps.instruction: Inject 10 µL of the reconstituted sample; run an 11‑min gradient: 5 % B hold 0.3 min, increase to 25 % B in 5.6 min, to 40 % B in 1.7 min, to 98 % B in 1.3 min, hold 1.0 min, return to initial conditions in 0.1 min and hold 1.0 min; detect with QTOF‑MS using SWATH acquisition.
